Readiness CONCERNS, so I went on. sprint-status.yaml is unchanged: Story 3.2's renamed heading keeps sprint key 3-2-the-pi-adapter, as its manifest and the approved 2026-10-25 proposal say. Epic 4 item 6 (correct course for Epic 4 drift) is still waiting on the Maintainer. Two open design questions stop the first Epic context compile, so I wrote no context file. Epic 5 has none.
Epic 6
- Story 6.4: What counts as a unit done per agent and model, which also feeds the median unit time and the first-pass review rate? Readings: (a) unit journal records with result done: counts builds that later park awaiting approval; (b) Stories whose PR merged in the period (6.4's forge read), under the agent and model of the builder record that built them: matches the Stories-per-hour figure; (c) journal records that end merged: misses Stories reconcile merged, so near zero while owner_approval_paths is ["**"].
- Story 6.4: Which row gets a review session's tokens and cost? Readings: (a) the builder's agent and model, as the journal records it today, since a unit record's cost includes its review passes: a claude row carries codex review spend; (b) the reviewer's agent and model, which needs reviewer usage as journal fields (today it is only in the reason text): each vendor's row shows only its own spend.
